firmware.title: BBC Micro
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; B-em
firmware.description: A BBC Micro Model B and Master 128 on B-em, with the OS, BASIC and DFS ROMs built in. Disc images stream from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard, NES/SNES/USB pad. F11: discs, F12: settings, Ctrl+Alt+Del: reset.
